urls.name: ChatGPT
urls.description: ChatGPT is an AI assistant for asking questions, drafting and editing text, summarizing information, learning, brainstorming, analyzing content, and getting help with coding and problem-solving.
use_cases: Draft, rewrite, and summarize emails, reports, and other documents
Learn about unfamiliar topics through explanations and follow-up questions
Explore ideas, plan tasks, and organize information
Get help understanding code and solving programming problems

urls.name: Claude
urls.description: Claude is an AI assistant from Anthropic for conversational help, writing, document analysis, summarization, research, reasoning, and software development tasks.
use_cases: Review and summarize long documents or supplied text
Draft, edit, and refine written material
Explore complex questions and compare possible approaches
Get assistance with code, debugging, and technical explanations

urls.name: Google Gemini
urls.description: Google Gemini is an AI assistant for answering questions, learning, writing, planning, and creative work, with availability and features that can vary by country, account, and device.
use_cases: Ask questions and get explanations on general topics
Get help with writing, rewriting, and creative ideas
Plan activities and organize personal or work tasks
Use supported Gemini experiences on compatible devices and accounts

urls.name: Microsoft Copilot
urls.description: Microsoft Copilot is an AI assistant for finding information, answering questions, drafting content, planning, and everyday productivity, with features that may differ across markets and account types.
use_cases: Explore questions and discover information from the web
Draft and improve everyday written content
Summarize information and develop ideas
Get assistance with personal and work-related tasks

urls.name: Perplexity
urls.description: Perplexity is an AI-powered search and answer service that helps users investigate questions, explore web information, and review linked sources in support of research.
use_cases: Research a topic and explore relevant web sources
Find source links related to a question
Compare information presented across multiple pages
Build an initial reading list for further research

urls.name: Hugging Face
urls.description: Hugging Face is a machine-learning collaboration platform for discovering, sharing, and working with AI models, datasets, interactive applications, and open-source development tools.
use_cases: Discover and compare machine-learning models for a project
Find and share datasets for AI and machine-learning work
Try interactive model demos and community applications
Collaborate on and publish AI development resources

urls.name: Google AI Studio
urls.description: Google AI Studio is a browser-based developer workspace for trying Gemini models, testing prompts, experimenting with model settings, and prototyping generative AI applications; access depends on supported regions and service terms.
use_cases: Test prompts and compare responses from supported Gemini models
Prototype generative AI ideas in a browser workspace
Explore model settings and supported capabilities
Prepare experiments before integrating the Gemini API into an application

urls.name: OpenAI Platform
urls.description: The OpenAI Platform provides developer tools, API documentation, and account resources for building applications with OpenAI models and services, subject to supported-country and service requirements.
use_cases: Build software applications that use OpenAI models and APIs
Read API guides and developer documentation
Manage developer platform projects and API resources
Explore model and platform capabilities for an application

urls.name: Anthropic
urls.description: Anthropic is an artificial intelligence research and product company that develops Claude and related AI technologies, and publishes information about its research, products, and approach to AI safety.
use_cases: Learn about Anthropic, its organization, and AI products
Explore information about Claude and related services
Read company research and material about AI safety
Find official company announcements and product resources

urls.name: GitHub Copilot
urls.description: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant that helps developers write, understand, and improve code through supported editors, chat experiences, and other GitHub development workflows.
use_cases: Get code suggestions while working in a supported editor
Ask for explanations of code and programming concepts
Support code writing, review, and development tasks
Use supported Copilot features within GitHub and development tools
